name: 30° Manual Dive
summary: Fixed sight, 30° dive, 450 kt, release at 4,500 ft

sight.notes: Mk-82 LD, 30° / 450 KCAS / 4,500 ft — check against the depression table for the actual load

procedure: Delivery mode DIRECT, weapon selected, sight depression set
Roll in, establish 30° and 450 kt — a steady dive is the whole trick
Pipper on the target at release altitude: pickle, 4 G recovery
source: community practice (Heatblur F-4E manual depression tables, estimated)

name: 45° Manual Dive
summary: Fixed sight, steep dive from 12,000 ft, release at 6,500 ft

sight.notes: Mk-82 LD, 45° / 450 KCAS / 6,500 ft — check against the depression table

procedure: Delivery mode DIRECT, weapon selected, sight depression set
Steep roll-in; throttle back to hold 450 kt
Pipper on at release altitude: pickle, 5 G recovery — do not press
source: community practice (Heatblur F-4E manual depression tables, estimated)

name: Dive Toss 30°
summary: Radar lock in the dive, pickle and pull — WRCS releases
procedure: WRCS: DIVE TOSS; radar in A/G, WSO ready to lock
Roll in, pipper on the target, radar lock (freeze) — pickle and hold
Pull 4 G straight through — the WRCS releases on its own

name: Laydown 500 ft (HD)
summary: Fast and low with Snakeyes — WRCS laydown or visual
procedure: WRCS: LAYDOWN with release range set, or DIRECT and pickle on the target
Level at 500 ft, 500 kt — hold it through release

name: LABS Loft 45°
summary: Low ingress, timed pull-up, LABS release
procedure: WRCS: LOFT, pull-up timer set for the run-in speed
Over the pull-up point: pickle and hold, 4 G to 45° nose up
Bomb releases on the timer — roll off and dive away
